note_tweet.text:
On December 1, Elon and SpaceX officially start building Terafab, the biggest building in human history.

Without it, there's no city on Mars.

A 100 million square foot chip factory in Grimes County, Texas (near College Station), more than 5 times the size of the largest building on Earth today.

- At least 2.5 miles long
- Nearly 3 Central Parks under one roof
- Brings its own power, off the Texas grid
- Every chip factory on Earth combined makes about 2% of what Elon needs
- Each year's chips will need twice the power of the entire US
- Chips for 1 billion Optimus robots, plus Cybercab, Grok and self-driving Teslas
- About 80% of the chips go to space
- The Moon: a city first, plus a magnetic rail that launches AI satellites into deep space
- Mars: robots land first to build, then people, in roughly 5 to 7 years by Elon's count

No chips, no robots. No robots, no city on Mars.

Most people would shrink the plan to fit the supply chain. Elon builds his own.

The next step to Mars isn't a rocket. It's a factory in Texas.

note_tweet.text:
My friend’s dad built a business from nothing. 30 years. Blood and sweat. Turned it into something worth $2,000,000.

Sold it in 2019 to a private equity firm.

They gutted it in 18 months. Cut 40 jobs. Raised prices 35%. Eliminated the pension plan he’d built for his employees. Squeezed every dollar out and sold the carcass.

He calls it the worst decision he ever made. Said he thought they’d protect what he built.

Private equity doesn’t buy businesses to run them. They buy them to harvest them. And they’re doing it to every industry you depend on daily.
